title: The Arithmetic of Semirings Part I: Ideals
summary: We study ideals in the semiring $\mathbb{N}$ of natural numbers, with a focus on those which are lost when extending from $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{Z}$. This leads to a new perspective on the classical theory of numerical semigroups, including the introduction of a natural multiplicative structure.
